# PlexMCP

> FastMCP 3.2 MCP server for Plex Media Server: portmanteau tools, LanceDB RAG, optional webapp (**10740** / **10741**), Tauri desktop installer.

**Full corpus:** see repo [docs/TOOLS.md](docs/TOOLS.md), [docs/CONFIGURATION.md](docs/CONFIGURATION.md), [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) if present.

## Quick start

1. **Desktop (recommended):** [Releases](https://github.com/sandraschi/plex-mcp/releases) → `Plex MCP_*_x64-setup.exe`
2. **stdio MCP:** `uv run python -m plex_mcp` with `PLEX_TOKEN` and `PLEX_URL`
3. **Webapp / Tauri:** backend **10740**, frontend **10741** — [docs/WEBAPP.md](docs/WEBAPP.md)
